veranderings.rede: 'tot hier' is wooden for 'so far'; 'tot dusver' is the natural Afrikaans expression.
The preceding sentences name several carriers, so 'so 'n draer' refers to the kind rather than to one specific carrier.
The previous sentence uses the plural 'radioseine', so singular 'Daardie sein' has no antecedent; 'Elke sein' fixes the reference and keeps the protected word 'sein'.
'stem' is countable and reads oddly as a bare mass noun here; the plural is natural.

veranderings.voor: net die een waarop jy instel
veranderings.na: net die golwe van die stasie waarop jy instel
veranderings.rede: 'die een' is ambiguous between a station and the waves, and it is the waves that the radio turns back into sound.

veranderings.voor: Daar het hulle nuus en musiek gehoor en ook sportuitslae en dramas.
veranderings.na: Daar het hulle nuus, musiek, sportuitslae en dramas gehoor.
veranderings.rede: The objects tacked on after the verb read as an afterthought; one list before the verb is natural Afrikaans word order.
Singular 'n radio' does not fit 'in motors' or 'op die internet'; radio as a medium that one finds in those places is natural.
The preposition 'langs' suggests travelling beside a wire; a message travels through a wire, and 'deur' matches the lesson's own usage.

veranderings.voor: Een van sy afdelings is Fisika.
veranderings.na: Een van die afdelings is Fisika.
veranderings.rede: 'sy' could refer to Alfred Nobel or to the prize; 'die' removes the ambiguity.

vlae.teks: sommige van Tesla se idees vroeër as Marconi s'n was
vlae.rede: Tesla is named for the first time here with no word on who he was, so a Grade 4 reader meets an unexplained name; fixing it would add content, so it is not changed.

vlae.teks: 'n Stasie se golwe reis ver oor sy eie gebied.
vlae.rede: 'ver oor' can be read as 'far beyond' its own area, which contradicts the next sentence; the intended meaning seems to be 'far across its own area', but rewording risks changing the claim, so it is flagged for the writer.
